verdict.rationale: Lium documents several first-party ways to keep a forgotten pod from running up a bill. The CLI takes `--ttl` to auto-remove a pod after a set time. Pod creation offers three auto-delete triggers: hours, an end time, or a USD spend cap. API keys carry daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets that the server enforces. `lium spend` shows hourly burn and remaining runway. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the TTL and spend-cap auto-deletion actually triggers reliably.
